title: MERN Stack Development with AI
description: Learn full-stack web development using MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js, and modern AI tools.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Frontend Development with React
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build modern and responsive user interfaces using React.js and component-based architecture.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Backend APIs with Node.js
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Create scalable REST APIs using Express.js and Node.js.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: MongoDB Database Integration
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Work with MongoDB, Mongoose, and database relationships.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Authentication & Security
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Implement JWT authentication, protected routes, and secure APIs.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: AI Integration in Web Apps
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Integrate AI tools and APIs such as OpenAI into MERN applications.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Deployment & Production
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Deploy frontend and backend applications using Vercel, Render, and cloud databases.

title: Python Django Development with AI
description: Master Python, Django, backend development, and AI-powered web applications.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Python Programming Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Learn Python syntax, OOP concepts, functions, and data structures.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Web Development with Django
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build powerful backend applications using the Django framework.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Database Management
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Work with PostgreSQL and Django ORM for efficient data handling.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Authentication System
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Implement login, registration, permissions, and role-based access.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: AI Integration with Python
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Use Python libraries and AI APIs to create intelligent applications.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Deployment & Hosting
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Deploy Django applications to cloud servers and production environments.

title: Next.js Development with AI
description: Build production-ready modern web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, and AI tools.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Modern Frontend Development
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build fast and optimized applications using Next.js and React.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Server Components & Rendering
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Understand SSR, SSG, ISR, and React Server Components.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: TypeScript Integration
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Write scalable and type-safe applications using TypeScript.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Authentication & Database
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Implement authentication systems and connect databases.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: AI Features in Applications
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Integrate AI-powered chat, content generation, and automation features.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Deployment & Optimization
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Deploy applications with performance optimization and SEO best practices.

title: Flutter
description: Build beautiful, high-performance cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS using Flutter and Dart.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Flutter Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Learn Flutter architecture, widgets, layouts, and project structure.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Dart Programming
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Master Dart language features including OOP, asynchronous programming, and collections.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: State Management
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build scalable applications using Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: REST APIs & Firebase
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Connect mobile apps with REST APIs and Firebase services.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Native Device Features
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Access camera, location, notifications, storage, and device sensors.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Publishing & Deployment
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Prepare, optimize, and publish applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

title: React Native
description: Develop cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS using React Native, TypeScript, and modern development tools.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: React Native Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build native mobile applications using React Native components and navigation.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: TypeScript Integration
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Develop scalable and maintainable applications with TypeScript.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: State Management
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Manage application state using Context API, Redux Toolkit, or Zustand.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: API & Firebase Integration
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Consume REST APIs, authenticate users, and integrate Firebase services.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: Native Device Features
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Work with camera, GPS, notifications, storage, biometric authentication, and permissions.

whatYouWillLearn.heading: App Publishing
whatYouWillLearn.detail: Build production-ready applications and publish them to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
